_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Enables only the Premier League and seeds its date-range schedule cache (key soccer_eng.1_schedule_20260101-20260129, derived from freeze_time +/- 14 days, consumed by the recent/upcoming managers) and the live scoreboard cache (key soccer_eng.1_scoreboard_current, consumed by SoccerLiveManager._fetch_todays_games) with one final, one in-progress, and one scheduled match so all three modes render real game cards without network access.
